name: Disbelief
overview: Scripture reveals that disbelief stems from the natural enmity of the carnal mind against God, which is neither subject to His law nor able to submit to it (Romans 8:7). Human hearts are depicted as continually inclined toward evil, demonstrating a deep-rooted resistance to God’s truth (Genesis 6:5). Yet, even in moments of wavering faith, believers are encouraged to earnestly seek help for their unbelief, exemplified by the father who cried out for assistance in believing (Mark 9:24). True blessing and righteousness come not merely from hearing God's word but from keeping it, highlighting the necessity of obedient faith (Luke 11:28).
